welcome.pointResearch: Evidence-backed briefs from permitted public sources
welcome.pointEvidence: Every fact opens the exact excerpt it came from
welcome.pointPrivate: Private to your account — no public sign-up
welcome.expiredBody: It expired or was signed out from another device. Sign in again to continue.
welcome.signedOut: You are signed out. Research data and temporary files were removed from this phone.
welcome.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
welcome.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Showing what is already open. New research, saving and exports need a connection — nothing is queued while offline.

errors.offlineBody: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeoutTitle: The server is taking too long
errors.timeoutBody: It may be starting up or busy. Research already running continues on the server; try again in a moment.
errors.incompatibleBody: The server sent data this version of the app does not understand. Install the latest version.
errors.configBody: This build has no valid server address.
errors.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or it belongs to a different account.
errors.sessionBody: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.providersTitle: Live research is not set up
errors.genericBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, the server may be unavailable.

system.misconfiguredBody: This build of PersonBrief does not know which server to use.
system.missing: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL for the {variant} build (see docs/mobile-setup.md).
system.insecure: Preview and store builds only connect to an https:// server.
system.invalid: The configured server address is not a valid URL.
system.upgradeBody: This version of the app is no longer supported by the server. Install the latest version to continue.
system.unreachableBody: You are still signed in on this phone, but the server could not be reached. Nothing is shown until it can be loaded from the server.

lock.title: PersonBrief is locked
lock.body: Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID, your fingerprint or the device passcode.
lock.failed: Not unlocked. Try again, or sign out — you can sign in again with your password.

search.title: Research
search.offlineNoResearch: You're offline. Connect to start research — searches are never queued offline.

brief.shareMessage: The file is created for your account and handed to the share sheet. Once shared to another app, that copy is outside PersonBrief.
brief.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
brief.notesSummary: {notes, plural, =0 {No notes} one {# private note} other {# private notes}} · {tags, plural, =0 {no tags} one {# tag} other {# tags}}
brief.oneVersion: Refresh the profile to create a second version.
brief.roleEvidenceHint: Opens the evidence for this role
brief.demoBrief: Fictional demo data — every person, organisation, source and contact here is invented.

contacts.evidenceHint: Opens where this contact was published
contacts.fictionalContact: Fictional demo contact — calling and emailing are disabled.

notes.deleteBody: The note is removed from this profile on every device.

settings.workspaceHint: The same setting as on the website. The demo workspace only contains invented people and sources.
settings.phoneHint: These settings apply to this phone only and are removed when you sign out.

push.title: Research notifications
push.on: On — a short notice when research finishes or needs your choice. The person's name is never shown.
push.lastFailed: The last notification could not be delivered ({error}).

unavailable.web: Not available in the web preview.
unavailable.simulator: Push notifications need a physical phone.
unavailable.no_project: Not available in this build: it is not linked to an Expo project with push credentials yet.

failed.denied: Notifications are not allowed for PersonBrief. Allow them in the phone's Settings.
failed.token_failed: This phone could not get a push token. Push credentials may not be set up for this build.
failed.server: The server could not register this phone. Try again later.
failed.web: Not available in the web preview.
failed.simulator: Push notifications need a physical phone.

lock.title: App lock
lock.on: On — Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint, with the device passcode as fallback.
lock.noHardware: This phone has no biometric unlock.
lock.notEnrolled: Set up Face ID, Touch ID or a fingerprint in the phone's Settings first.

settings.setupOnServer: Live research needs TAVILY_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server (web service and worker). Keys are never shown in the app.
settings.limitsHint: Hard budgets for each run, set on the server. They can be lowered on the website.
settings.noUsage: No provider usage in the last 30 days.
settings.sessionsHint: See where this account is signed in and sign other devices out
settings.signOutBody: This phone's session is revoked on the server, notifications are turned off, and research data and temporary files are removed from the phone.

sessions.intro: Every browser and phone signed in to this account. Signing one out takes effect immediately.
sessions.revokeBody: It will need the password to sign in again.
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in.} one {# device was signed out.} other {# devices were signed out.}}
sessions.expiryNote: Sessions end after 7 days without use. Signing out on this phone also turns off its notifications.

dataUse.sessionBody: Only the session cookie is stored, in the phone's secure keychain/keystore. Your password is never stored.
dataUse.contentBody: Briefs, sources and notes are loaded from your server and kept in memory while the app runs. There is no offline copy on the phone.
dataUse.exportsBody: PDF and JSON files are created for your account, placed in a private temporary folder and deleted after sharing, at the next launch and on sign-out.
dataUse.sharedBody: A file you send to another app (Mail, Files, a chat) becomes that app's copy. PersonBrief cannot delete it.
dataUse.notificationsBody: Optional. They only say that research finished or needs your choice — never who was researched — and stop when you sign out.
dataUse.lockBody: Optional. Face ID, Touch ID or a fingerprint hides the app on this phone; it does not replace signing in.
